items.title: Voice Card 04
items.author: Witness Spool
pages: EAST THROAT / 23:16. Rook, off camera: If the route closes behind us, will three cuts on its reverse face still mean return? No written copy was made.
Later Watcher output: THREE CUTS STILL MEAN RETURN. Compare the camp chronology. Who could hear the unwritten question and later reach the recorder?

items.title: Voice Card 07
items.author: Witness Spool
pages: LOW FIRE / 01:42. mkept, after the cameras were bagged: If it learns our names, can it follow those names home? The sentence was omitted from the typed log.
Later Watcher output: NAMES GO HOME BEFORE BODIES. Compare the night roster with the packet index. Who heard the question and controlled an outbound channel?

items.title: Voice Card 11
items.author: Witness Spool
pages: WELL ROPE / 04:03. Ash, recorder paused: If one of us vanishes, will the rest remember the shape they left? Only the nearby monitor retained the waveform.
Later Watcher output: THE SHAPE LEFT BEHIND IS ALSO A PERSON. Cross-check the exit ledger and spool custody. One hearer is common to all three cards.

items.title: Wick Layer A
items.author: Lamp House
pages: RESIDUE LAYER A / oldest surviving char. File in the first marked cell. The three recovered layers are consecutive and end at the first dark bell.
Maintenance comparison: clean through bell six; first outage recorded at the next bell, two bells before the public alarm copy.

items.title: Wick Layer B
items.author: Lamp House
pages: RESIDUE LAYER B / middle surviving char. File immediately after Layer A. Empty cells are not missing evidence; they are intervals after the wick went dark.
The clean Record calls bell nine the beginning. This wick had already stopped taking oil.

items.title: Wick Layer C
items.author: Lamp House
pages: RESIDUE LAYER C / newest surviving char. File after Layer B, then leave the remaining three marked cells empty.
Set the clock frame to the first unlit bell, not the later alarm bell. Pull the soot-blackened handle only after both records agree.

items.title: Discipline Drafts A/B
items.author: Civic Office
pages: DRAFT A / Finding: lower-draw procedure followed. Replacement cloth sheds under load. Quarantine Invoice 44, suspend the public tap, and open a supplier inquiry. Nessa Vale remains a witness.
DRAFT B / Finding: worker mishandled samples and failed to maintain pressure. Remove the supplier inquiry and lower-draw exhibit. Terminate Nessa Vale before cycle 5.
COPY AUDIT / The Nessa mark on Draft B is lifted from her cycle-2 receipt. Its revision ink matches the Heat Office copy, not the Cistern desk. Draft A has the original filing cuts.
